authorization: User requested continued work during V28; existing routine implementation/CPU validation authorization.
scope: One minimal C++ CPU interface probe directly calling the existing canonical Karto occupancy library. Fixed artificial coordinates/ranges/counters only. No World, Node, complete Mapper, task scene, episode, ENV.step, actor, policy, reward replay, native physics or GPU.
purpose: Test actual reuse and record incompatibilities before designing a proxy adapter. No V4 score/threshold candidate or task quality comparison.
implementation: Thin derived fixed-size OccupancyGrid initializes counter grids through CreateFromScans(empty); expose original RayTrace/AddScan/Update/count access without rewriting algorithms or changing SDK defaults.
source_and_binary: Canonical source include directory and canonical current build/slam_toolbox/lib/karto_sdk/libkartoSlamToolbox.so, exact bytes/SHA before and after. Compile against that absolute library and explicit rpath with cleaned loader environment; verify runtime /proc/self/maps path. Do not mix /opt headers or same-SONAME library.
fixed_questions: Round at half cells, grid center/offset and padded row stride versus ROS boundary-origin and floor semantics.
Raw uint8 Unknown=0/Occupied=100/Free=255 must be explicitly exported to -1/100/0.
Per-beam pass/hit counters, valid-hit endpoint extra pass/hit, native pass>2 and hit/pass>.1 classification; no score retuning.
Explicit kernel no-hit ray carving versus native AddScan skipping min/max readings and threshold clipping/nohit.
Uniform LaserRangeFinder expected sample count, Validate before AddScan, estimated pose and sensor offset applied exactly once.
The SDK has no scan ID deduplication, saturation or atomic out-of-map rollback; do not expose it to actor without an explicit adapter contract.
limits: Small fixed grids and finite rays only, counter increments far below uint32 overflow. Compiler timeout 90s; probe timeout 20s, owned process group termination/wait on failure. No retry without a concrete implementation correction and new output paths; preserve failures.
interpretation: Interface/counter checks may pass despite differences. Reuse is not scan matching, bias correction, native SLAM equivalence or task quality. Same input cannot be silently resampled, range-adjusted or half-cell shifted to fit a prior result.
unchanged: Default v1, disabled v2/v3, worker/evaluator/actor/candidates/task/quality/95percent/300s/received-only/TTL/FIFO/native gates and historical evidence.
